title: APPROVAL OF CONTRACT AMENDMENT AND CONSENT TO ASSIGNMENT TO SPECIFICATION NO. 2838 AND CONTRACT NO. 2331 BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES AND RESOURCE ENVIRONMENTAL, INC.
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVAL OF CONTRACT AMENDMENT AND CONSENT TO ASSIGNMENT TO SPECIFICATION NO. 2838 AND CONTRACT NO. 2331 BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES AND RESOURCE ENVIRONMENTAL, INC.
Transmittal 1
Summary
: Staff requests approval of a Contract Amendment and Consent to Assignment to Specification No. 2838 and Contract No. 2331 to change the name of the Contractor from Resource Environmental, Inc. to Resource Environmental Services LLC. This transaction is the result of an ownership transfer. The new parent company is QDR Holdings LLC, registered with the State of Delaware as a limited liability company. All other terms of the contract will remain the same. The City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) will continue to be financially responsible for payment of expenses incurred under Specification No. 2838 and Contract No. 2331.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the name change of the Contractor, from Resource Environmental, Inc. to Resource Environmental Services LLC, as a result of transfer of ownership to QDR Holdings LLC; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest said Contract Amendment and Consent to Assignment for and on behalf of the Board; and 4) adopt Resolution No.____________. .
Construction & Maintenance
summary: Approval of contract amendment to change contractor name from Resource Environmental, Inc. to Resource Environmental Services LLC due to ownership transfer.
